narration.text: A snack maker's recall of a supplier's almond butter is traced: three lots held and five customers told, one for a batch reworked into another product, while the lots either side of the range, batches made from them, a customer given only other batches, an order not yet shipped and the distributor's own customers are left alone. This is a chore for the quality lead and owner of a small snack-bar company in Duluth, Minnesota, with a distributor, six retail customers and a supplier's recall notice in her mail. On the bench, she found 8 of 8 eligible items, worth 20,000 dollars of the 20,000 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 10 traps, and she walked past 10. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 3 hours, so she was about 112 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
